about: Holds of the spouse-phrase lint (engine/src/spouse-phrase.ts; interview/README.md, 'A joint return combines both spouses' items') by input: once-per-return questions whose prompt says 'you' with no couple phrase, each with the reason the bare 'you' is right as written. A hit not held fails, and so does a hold no longer a hit (unscoped), so the list only shrinks.
